verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents telephony support: carrier webhooks for Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel and SIP, plus SIP/PSTN transports. However, no evidence shows a warm or blind transfer of a live call to a human, or passing context to that human. Multi-agent specialist handoff and Flows functions that call external APIs are agent-to-agent orchestration and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit toward human call transfer.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along
